description: Searches events, activities, places and guides at once by name or text, for when the kind of thing is not known in advance. Each hit says which kind it is and carries the slug to pass to get_event or get_place.

query.description: What to look for. At least two characters — one matches most of the catalogue.

type.description: Restrict to one kind. Omit to search everything.

name: search_all

attribution.description: Who to credit and under what licence. The ODbL datasets behind most of this data require attribution wherever the data is used, including inside an answer you generate.

data.description: Upstream datasets and their licences. ODbL requires naming them wherever the data is used.

url.description: The site these records come from.

counts.description: How many matched per kind — useful for saying 'also 12 places' without a second call.

hits.description: Matches across every kind, best first.

next_start.description: Next occurrence, for the dated types. Null for places.

slug.description: Pass this to get_event or get_place.

title.description: In its own language. Never translated.

type.description: Which kind of thing this is — it decides which capability to call next.

title: Search everything in Paris
